speaker: Wounded Kiltias
line_text: I was guiding refugees to the holy mountain, when, ahead at the Spine of the Icewyrm, we were set upon by a feral retriever! / You have defeated the feral retriever? Once again, those seeking the holy mountain may travel in safety.

speaker: Wounded Kiltias
line_text: The fell wyrm Fafnir, buried for long millennia beneath the snows, has returned in a furious blizzard by the Silverflow's End. A group of Kiltias went to face it, but I am afraid their attacks were met with fierce resistance by the creature. Even their leader, brave Ieeha, was powerless. I could only watch from the opposite side, cursing my lack of strength as ne'er before. / You have defeated Fafnir? Then the holy mountain is saved... That...that is Ieeha's ring! How did you come to carry this? You found it when you slew Fafnir? I see. Then our brother Ieeha is no more. Gods guide his passing. Faram.

speaker: Refugee
line_text: If you go to Mt Bur-Omisace, you go the wrong way. Head southeast down the slope, then to the north. I've lost my way too many times here... / What was that airship just now? The nu mou over there went all pale and galloped off towards Mt Bur-Omisace!

speaker: Refugee
line_text: Everywhere you go in Ivalice, there is war. Only on Mt Bur-Omisace do we refugees find peace. / Mt Bur-Omisace has no military to defend itself. Should an army invade, it would be over in the blink of an eye...

speaker: Acolyte
line_text: The Stilshrine of Miriam ahead has been warded by His Grace the Gran Kiltias. You must first go to Mt Bur-Omisace, if you wish passage there. / To walk this rift in ice and snow, this is part of our asceticism. Go up this slope, and south from there to reach the Stilshrine of Miriam.
